threads.author: Kevin Curtis
threads.summary: A Vacasa job showed a 497-mile client travel distance against a true ~80 miles. Adjet traced it to the client typing "49,7" - the comma was stripped rather than parsed, turning it into 497.
threads.note: COP-2084 filed today for the decimal-comma validation defect, which had no owner for three runs. Line item 94704 still carries the bad 497 while parent 94703 was corrected to 82 - Jordan to clear the child record.
